I can´t believe that 10 years ago we presented our prototype of Pitiri 1977 to the world! 10 years dudes! Makes me feel like an indie veteran somehow.

notes.title: Pitiri 1977 - FAQ
notes.notes:
[b] Is the Pitiri 1977 soundtrack included?[/b]
Yes it is! Go to the folder: Steam\SteamApps\common\Pitiri1977 and you´ll find the full soundtrack of the game!

[b] Can I order one of the Pitiri 1977 mixtapes?[/b]
No, unfortunately not. I have created only 5 Mixtape-Prototypes on my old Sony stereo. But you will find the mixtape cover within the SOUNDTRACK folder! So you can create your own Pitiri 1977 mixtape!

[b] Do I get a steam key when I have bought the “Clickteam Humble Bundle”?[/b]
Yes you do! It has been part of the Humble Bundle deal, that buyers would also get a steam key when the game is finally released.

[b] Will the game be available on “steam sales”?[/b]
Yes it will! We love the steam sales – as players and as developers.

[b] Can I play Pitiri 1977 in windowed mode?[/b]
No. The current version is full screen only.

[b] Xbox 360 controller support?[/b]
No. This is something I´d love to see too, but there´s just not enough time to implement this feature. Sorry folks.
